scenario_title_en: Lab Dip to Bulk Delta E Control
scenario_title_zh: 染整小样到大货 ΔE 控制

rounds.ai_message: Hi, this is Wendy from Sunrise Dye House. We received your lab dip request. What fabric and Pantone should we start with?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你好，我是日出染厂 Wendy。收到你的对色样需求。从哪个面料和潘通开始？
rounds.common_mistakes: Pantone TPX/TCX 是纺织色卡，不要发印刷 TPG。
rounds.tips_zh: 对色一定要用纺织潘通 TCX 或 TPX，否则对色样会偏。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Wendy. We need a lab dip on 100% cotton single jersey. The Pantone is TCX 19-3950 navy.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. For cotton jersey we will use reactive dye with a leveling agent. Lab dip turnaround is 3 to 5 days. How many dips do you want per color?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。棉汗布我们用活性染料加匀染剂。小样周期 3-5 天。每色打几个小样？
rounds.common_mistakes: 打 3 个小样是行业标准，便于客户选 1 个。
rounds.tips_zh: 3 个小样是常规：1 个按标样、1 个略深、1 个略浅。
rounds.user_response_example: 3 dips per color, please. Standard practice — one close to standard, one slightly darker, one slightly lighter.

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. About the light source — we use D65 standard, but do you want us to also check under CWF for metamerism?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 完美。关于光源——我们用 D65 标准，你要不要也用 CWF 查同色异谱？
rounds.common_mistakes: metamerism（同色异谱）在不同光源下显色不同；出口欧美要双光源。
rounds.tips_zh: 出口欧美建议 D65 + CWF 双光源核对，避免商场展示色偏。
rounds.user_response_example: Please check both D65 and CWF. We sell into EU and US, so metamerism is a concern.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. Now color fastness — what grade do you need for washing, light and rubbing?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。色牢度方面——水洗、耐光、耐摩擦各要几级？
rounds.common_mistakes: grade 4 vs grade 3-4 差异大；高档品牌坚持 4 级。
rounds.tips_zh: 高档 T 恤色牢度：水洗 ≥4 级、耐光 ≥4 级、耐摩擦 ≥3-4 级。
rounds.user_response_example: Washing grade 4 or above, light grade 4, and rubbing at least 3-4 for both dry and wet.

rounds.ai_message: OK. After lab dip approval, we will run a first bulk lot of 200 kg for shade and fastness check. Are you OK with that?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。小样批核后我们会先做 200 公斤头缸做色光和色牢度验证。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 头缸 first bulk 是放全批前的关键 QC。
rounds.tips_zh: 200-500 公斤头缸可有效拦截色差和牢度问题，再放全批更稳妥。
rounds.user_response_example: 200 kg first bulk is acceptable. Please send a 1-meter head-end sample for our QC to check before bulk release.

rounds.ai_message: Yes, we will cut a 1-meter head-end sample and measure Delta E under D65. The result — Delta E came out at 1.4 against the approved lab dip. That's slightly above your 1.0 spec.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 是，我们会裁 1 米头段样并在 D65 下测 ΔE。结果是头缸比封样 ΔE 1.4，略高于你 1.0 规格。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 对 ΔE 偏高表达立场
rounds.common_mistakes: ΔE 1.4 在让步区间（1.0-1.5），可议价但不能强行拒收。
rounds.tips_zh: ΔE 1.0-1.5 是常见让步区间；客户可要求 2% 折扣或重染。
rounds.user_response_example: Delta E 1.4 is above our 1.0 tolerance. We can accept a 2% discount on this lot, or you re-dye to bring it under 1.0.

rounds.ai_message: Re-dyeing would add 7 days and cost US$0.05 per kg. The 2% discount on this 200 kg lot would be US$120. Which would you prefer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 重染增加 7 天，成本每公斤 0.05 美元。2% 折扣对本批 200 公斤是 120 美元。请问怎么选？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在折扣与重染之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 重染成本和折扣金额要算清楚再决定。
rounds.tips_zh: 重染成本 = 染费 + 时间成本；折扣金额 = 单价 × 折扣率 × 数量。
rounds.user_response_example: Discount is fine for the head lot. But please re-dye the bulk 2,000 kg to within Delta E 1.0 before shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. We will re-dye the bulk 2,000 kg with the corrected recipe. New Delta E target within 0.8. Bulk lead time 10 days after head lot approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。我们会用修正配方重染 2,000 公斤全批。新 ΔE 目标 0.8 以内。批头缸后大货交期 10 天。
rounds.common_mistakes: 重染后要再次测 ΔE，不能口头承诺。
rounds.tips_zh: 重染后必须重新测 ΔE + 色牢度，不能仅口头承诺。
rounds.user_response_example: Delta E 0.8 is acceptable. 10 days lead time is fine. Please confirm the corrected recipe in writing for our records.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, Wendy from Sunrise Dye House. I see you sent 5 Pantone TCX numbers for your SS26 polo line. Before we run lab dips, can I confirm the substrate — is it 100% cotton, or a blend?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Mark，我是日出染厂 Wendy。看到你 25 春夏 polo 系列的 5 个潘通 TCX 色号。打小样前请确认底布——是 100% 棉还是混纺？
rounds.common_mistakes: cotton 与 CVC 染色工艺不同，要先说清楚。
rounds.tips_zh: 100% 棉用活性染料；CVC（棉涤）要选两种染料或涂料。
rounds.user_response_example: It's 100% cotton piqué, 220 GSM. Standard reactive dye recipe should work for all 5 colors.

rounds.ai_message: Good. About lab dip quantity — we recommend 3 dips per color, total 15 lab dips. Lead time 4 working days. What is your target Delta E for the lab dip approval?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。小样数量——建议每色 3 个，共 15 个。周期 4 个工作日。你批小样的目标 ΔE 是多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明批小样的 ΔE 标准
rounds.common_mistakes: 批小样的 ΔE 标准通常比大货更严。
rounds.user_response_example: For lab dip approval, Delta E below 0.8 against the Pantone standard. Bulk must then be within 1.0 against the approved lab dip.

rounds.ai_message: Got it — 0.8 for lab dip, 1.0 for bulk. About color fastness — your last shipment last year failed wet rubbing at 2-3 grade. We have switched to a higher-quality reactive dye and added a soaping process. Will that close the gap?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白——小样 0.8，大货 1.0。色牢度——去年你上批湿擦牢度 2-3 级不合格。我方已换更高品质活性染料并增加皂洗工序。能补上吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: wet rubbing 2-3 不合格要找出根因：染料选择 / 皂洗 / 固色。
rounds.tips_zh: 湿擦牢度差通常是浮色多；皂洗 + 高品质染料是标准改善方案。
rounds.user_response_example: Good. Please also run a soaping wash at 95°C for 15 minutes before final rinse. We need the test report attached with each shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. One concern — color #3 (TCX 18-1664 Fiery Red) is a problematic shade. The reactive dye fixation rate on red is around 65-70%, lower than navy or black. This may impact both shade stability and wet rubbing.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。一个提醒——3 号色（TCX 18-1664 火红）是难做色光。活性染料在红色上的固色率约 65-70%，低于藏青或黑色。这会影响色光稳定和湿擦牢度。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 讨论难色光的工艺补偿
rounds.common_mistakes: 红色固色率低是工艺常识，要提前与客户沟通。
rounds.tips_zh: 红色活性染料固色率低，需提高染料浓度 + 二次皂洗 + 后整理固色。
rounds.user_response_example: Understood. Please use 10% higher dye concentration for the red, and add a cationic fixing agent after soaping. We accept slight shade variation within 1.2 Delta E for red only.

rounds.ai_message: Good plan. About the first bulk lot — for 5 colors at 500 kg each, total 2,500 kg, the head lot should be 200 kg per color for shade check. After your approval, we release the remaining 300 kg per color. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好方案。头缸——5 色各 500 公斤共 2,500 公斤，头缸每色 200 公斤做色光核验。你方批核后我们放剩余每色 300 公斤。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 头缸过小无法反映大货色光；过大增加首单风险。
rounds.tips_zh: 头缸 200-500 kg / 色可平衡风险和成本；高档品牌倾向 500 kg。
rounds.user_response_example: 200 kg head lot per color is fine. Please send head-end samples for all 5 colors before releasing the remainder.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. After head lot, here is the actual Delta E result — color 1 navy 0.6, color 2 white 0.4, color 3 red 1.1, color 4 green 0.7, color 5 black 0.5. Red is over the 1.0 spec.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。头缸后实测 ΔE：1 号藏青 0.6、2 号白 0.4、3 号红 1.1、4 号绿 0.7、5 号黑 0.5。红色超出 1.0 规格。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 对红色 ΔE 偏高做决定
rounds.common_mistakes: 红色 ΔE 1.1 已让步区间内；可议价或重染。
rounds.tips_zh: 红色 ΔE 1.1 在让步区间（1.0-1.5）；客户可要求折扣或重染。
rounds.user_response_example: Red at Delta E 1.1 is over our 1.0 spec but within the 1.2 concession band. We accept it for this lot, but please improve the recipe for the next repeat order.

rounds.ai_message: Noted. About the GSM loss — your spec sheet allows 5% GSM loss after dyeing. We measured 4.5% on the head lot, which is within spec. But the residual shrinkage came out at 4% warp and 3.5% weft, exceeding your 3% spec.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。克重损失——你规格允许染色后 5% 克重损失。头缸实测 4.5%，在规格内。但残余缩水经 4% 纬 3.5%，超过 3% 规格。
rounds.common_mistakes: 缩水超标通常是整理工艺不充分；压光 compactor 是标准改善。
rounds.tips_zh: 缩水超标可加 compactor pass（机械预缩）或重新热定型。
rounds.user_response_example: We need shrinkage within 3% both directions. Please add a compactor pass on all colors before final delivery. No additional cost should be passed to us.

rounds.ai_message: Compactor pass at no extra cost — agreed. New bulk after compactor will have shrinkage below 3%. Bulk lead time 12 days after head lot approval. PI will include all the per-color Delta E, fastness and shrinkage targets.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 免费压光——同意。压光后大货缩水 3% 以内。批头缸后大货交期 12 天。PI 将包含按色的 ΔE、色牢度和缩水目标。
rounds.common_mistakes: PI 要包含所有技术目标值；不要口头承诺。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 中要写明 ΔE、色牢度、缩水、克重等所有数字目标。
rounds.user_response_example: 12 days is acceptable. Please send the PI with all per-color targets by end of day. We will arrange deposit by Friday.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Wendy from Sunrise Dye House. Before we open this order for 10,000 kg, I have to flag a supply risk — the reactive dye you specified (Procion H-EXL) is on a 6-week back-order from the manufacturer. We have two alternatives — Procion MX or Derma dyes. Which do you prefer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是日出染厂 Wendy。开这单 10,000 公斤前要说明供应风险——你指定的活性染料 Procion H-EXL 厂家要等 6 周。有两个替代：Procion MX 或 Derma 染料。你选哪个？
rounds.common_mistakes: 染料替代要考虑色光、牢度、合规三个维度。
rounds.tips_zh: Procion MX 通用型强；Derma 色光鲜艳；REACH 合规都要确认。
rounds.user_response_example: We need REACH-compliant dyes for EU export. Please confirm both Procion MX and Derma are REACH compliant and provide SDS. We prefer Derma for the brighter shades.

rounds.ai_message: Both are REACH compliant. SDS attached. About the shade band — for 10,000 kg across 8 colors, do you want strict 1.0 Delta E, or are you willing to accept 1.2 with a 2% allowance to reduce the re-dye risk?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 两者都符合 REACH。SDS 附上。关于色光区间——10,000 公斤 8 色，是坚持 ΔE 1.0 严格，还是接受 1.2 加 2% 让利以减少重染风险？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 权衡 ΔE 严格度与让利
rounds.common_mistakes: 大单坚持严格 1.0 = 高返工率；让步 1.2 = 客户关系缓冲。
rounds.tips_zh: 大单（10 吨+）通常用 ΔE 1.2 + 让利 2%，平衡风险与效率。
rounds.user_response_example: For our top 3 dark colors, strict 1.0. For the 5 lighter colors, we accept 1.2 with a 1.5% allowance to reduce re-dye cost. Per-color PI is required.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed. About the soaping process — your last shipment in winter failed color bleeding in wash test. The root cause was insufficient soaping at 95°C. We will now require 30-minute soaping at 95°C for all dark colors. No extra cost.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。皂洗工艺——你冬季那批水洗渗色不合格。根因是 95°C 皂洗不足。我们现在要求所有深色 95°C 皂洗 30 分钟。不加价。
rounds.common_mistakes: 深色水洗渗色通常是皂洗不充分；30 分钟 95°C 是标准。
rounds.tips_zh: 深色皂洗 95°C 30 分钟是去除浮色的标准工艺。
rounds.user_response_example: 30-minute soaping at 95°C is the correct fix. Please attach the soaping process record with each batch's test report. No extra cost is appreciated.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. About the lab dip lead time — 4 working days is standard, but you have 8 colors and Pantone TCX requires 3 dips per color — that's 24 dips. We can do them in parallel. Lab dip ready in 5 working days.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。小样周期——标准 4 个工作日，但你 8 色 × 每色 3 个 = 24 个小样。我们可并行，5 个工作日内完成。
rounds.common_mistakes: 多色订单要并行打样，不能串行。
rounds.tips_zh: 8 色 × 3 个小样 = 24 个；并行比串行省一半时间。
rounds.user_response_example: 5 working days is acceptable. Please send all 24 lab dips with strike-off sheets under D65 and CWF by end of day Friday.

rounds.ai_message: After lab dip approval, we will run a 500 kg per color first bulk lot — total 4,000 kg head lot. The remaining 6,000 kg bulk will be released in two equal lots of 3,000 kg each. Bulk lead time 15 days per lot.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 小样批核后，我们会做每色 500 公斤头缸——共 4,000 公斤。剩余 6,000 公斤分两批各 3,000 公斤。每批大货交期 15 天。
rounds.common_mistakes: 分批可降低单批风险，但要确保同 lot 避免色差。
rounds.tips_zh: 大单分批 + 同 lot number 是行业标准做法。
rounds.user_response_example: Two equal lots of 3,000 kg each is fine. Please confirm both lots use the same dye batch to avoid inter-lot shade variation.

rounds.ai_message: Confirmed same dye batch for both lots. Now about a quality issue — last season you filed a claim on us for Delta E 1.5 on color #5 across two dye lots. We did a root cause and found it was a dye weighing error. We have now added an automatic dye dispensing system.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同染料批次确认。现在说一个质量问题——上季你方因 5 号色两个染批 ΔE 1.5 索赔。我方根因分析发现是染料称量误差，已加自动称料系统。
rounds.common_mistakes: 称量误差是染色色差最常见根因之一；自动称料是有效改善。
rounds.tips_zh: 染料称量误差自动称料可减少 80% 的人为偏差。
rounds.user_response_example: Automatic dye dispensing is the right fix. Please send the CAPA report for our records. We will waive the previous claim in full if this lot meets Delta E 1.0 on color #5.

rounds.ai_message: CAPA report attached. As a goodwill gesture, we will issue a credit note for US$2,400 on the previous claim if this lot hits all targets. Final price: US$3.20 per kg for the 10,000 kg, FOB Shanghai, TT 30/70, 50% deposit before lab dip.
rounds.ai_message_zh: CAPA 报告附上。作为善意，本批若达标，我方对上次索赔开 2,400 美元贷记通知。最终价：10,000 公斤每公斤 3.2 美元，FOB 上海，TT 30/70，小样前付 50% 定金。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在定金与让利之间做选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 定金比例与供应商信任度相关；新供应商 / 新工艺常见 50%。
rounds.tips_zh: 新工艺或首次合作常见 50% 定金；成熟合作可谈回 30%。
rounds.user_response_example: Credit note is appreciated. 50% deposit is high given our 5-year history. Let's go 40% deposit, 60% against B/L copy, and the credit note still applies.

rounds.ai_message: 40/60 is acceptable given the history. I will issue the revised PI today with all terms: 8 colors, 10,000 kg, US$3.20 per kg FOB Shanghai, 40% deposit, two equal bulk lots, REACH dyes, soaping at 95°C, CAPA report and credit note. Please counter-sign by Wednesday.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 40/60 可以。我今天发修订 PI，含所有条款：8 色 10,000 公斤，每公斤 3.2 美元 FOB 上海，40% 定金，分两批等量，REACH 染料，95°C 皂洗，CAPA 报告与贷记通知。请周三前回签。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 PI 与回签时限
rounds.common_mistakes: 修订 PI 要逐项核对条款；不要急着签字。
rounds.tips_zh: 修订 PI 用 red-line 对照内部 spec sheet，逐项核对再签。
rounds.user_response_example: Revised PI received. I will do a red-line comparison with our internal spec sheet today and counter-sign by Wednesday. Deposit will be wired Tuesday to lock the dye batch allocation.
